limitations: This is a bounded independent source review, not external cryptographic review or release authorization.
Consumer mutation tests use synthetic receipts and mocked executors; actual final-artifact proof, H0 and fresh nTime lifecycle qualification remains required.
No production artifact, deployment, activation, mainnet, public cutover or physical ASIC qualification is established by this review.

reported_validation.name: shell syntax and diff whitespace checks

reviewed_properties: Explicit v0.11.5 source configuration precedes combined and historical consumers.
Consumer executes the source-owned checker with final-artifact flags rather than accepting a caller receipt.
Source, authority, manifest and artifact snapshots are checked before and after execution.
Exactly four ordered node, wallet, walletd and private-spend package/binary rows are required before mapping projection.
Receipt scope, software version, artifact identity, boolean types and all authority boundaries are checked.
The nTime software candidate has a distinct audit mode and preserves historical consumer modes.
Latest ordered artifact-row defense and its missing, duplicate, reordered and wrong-package mutations were independently reviewed.
scope: v0.11.5 crypto-profile consumer routing, receipt rejection boundaries, audit classification and mutation controls
